How to recover from facelift, breast augmentation, tummy tuck and liposuction surgery.

Hi, I'm Kathleen Helen Lisson. My videos provide tips on reducing swelling after plastic surgery. I am a lymphedema therapist and NCBTMB Board Certified Massage therapist. I am the author of Facelift Recovery Handbook, Plastic Surgery Recovery Handbook and Lipedema Treatment Guide. I provide manual lymphatic drainage for post-surgical swelling and fibrosis as well as longevity massage in San Diego. I also teach Plastic Surgery Recovery and Fibrosis Massage classes for CEU credit.
